(Search snippet content — retrieved via search 18:18 GMT 25 Oct; Al Jazeera's and CNN's own reporting language. Second URL: https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/20/middleeast/uk-military-saudi-arabia-yemen-houthis-intl)
BACKGROUND ONLY — dated 20 October 2026, not today's news.
- The UK will fly "defensive counter-air missions" using RAF Typhoon fighter jets to protect Saudi cities and critical infrastructure, the Ministry of Defence said.
- UK military advisers to work with Saudi staff officers; an A400M transport aircraft to move defence material within the kingdom.
- The Typhoons will intercept missiles and drones and will not conduct offensive strikes inside Yemen.
- Defence Secretary Wes Streeting: "The continuing attacks from the Houthis on our ally Saudi Arabia are absolutely despicable. The targeting of the airport in Riyadh in particular shows the lengths the Houthis are going to escalate the situation in the region."
